name: Occupational Personality Questionnaire (OPQ32r)
description: The OPQ32r measures personality traits that influence performance at work. It provides insights into how someone will fit into a team, their working style, and their leadership potential. Best for professional, graduate, and managerial roles.

name: Verify G+ (General Ability)
description: Verify G+ assesses three types of cognitive ability: Numerical, Deductive, and Inductive reasoning. It provides a comprehensive view of an individual's general cognitive ability, which is strongly linked to job performance in most roles.

name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Assesses the ability to make correct decisions or inferences from numerical or statistical data. Ideal for roles involving financial analysis, data interpretation, and business analytics.

name: Verify Deductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to draw logical conclusions based on provided information. Useful for roles requiring logical thinking and problem-solving, such as software development and engineering.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to work with incomplete information and create solutions to novel problems from first principles. Important for technical, engineering, and analytical roles.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Evaluates the ability to read, understand, and extract key information from complex written texts. Essential for managerial, legal, and communication-heavy roles.

name: Scenarios (Managerial Judgement)
description: A situational judgement test that assesses a candidate's managerial judgement and decision-making skills in realistic, work-related situations. Designed for assessing leadership capabilities.

name: Java 8 (New)
description: Measures knowledge and skills in Java 8 programming, including syntax, lambdas, streams, and concurrency. Ideal for mid-level to senior Java developers.

name: Python 3 Developer
description: Assesses proficiency in Python 3 programming, including data structures, object-oriented concepts, and standard libraries. Suitable for backend developers and data engineers.

name: Customer Contact Scenario
description: Evaluates how candidates handle typical customer service interactions. Tests for customer focus, patience, and problem-solving in frontline roles.

name: Sales Scenarios
description: Assesses judgement in sales contexts, measuring a candidate's approach to identifying opportunities, handling objections, and closing deals.

name: Universal Competency Framework (UCF)
description: Provides a comprehensive mapping of workplace behaviors aligned to organizational needs. Often used in conjunction with OPQ32 to map personality to specific job competencies.

name: Motivational Questionnaire (MQ)
description: Explores the situations and conditions that increase or decrease an individual's motivation at work. Useful for understanding what drives a candidate and how they prefer to be managed.

name: Cognitive Ability Test (General)
description: A short, adaptive test measuring general cognitive ability, providing a quick read on reasoning and problem-solving potential for high-volume entry-level hiring.

name: Data Science Knowledge Assessment
description: Evaluates foundational and advanced concepts in data science, including machine learning algorithms, statistics, and data manipulation. Ideal for data scientists and analysts.
